{{Quote|Here is the power to wrench fire from the stars&hellip;|Exar Kun|<ref name="TSW4" />}}
Causing '''supernovas''' through [[Sith sorcery/Legends|Sith sorcery]] was a [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] [[Force power/Legends|ability]] that allowed the conjurer, his or her power amplified by Sith crystals, to purge the core from a [[Star/Legends|star]], thereby causing a stellar explosion. This ability had the potential to backfire on the conjurer.

==Description==
With the use of ancient Sith crystals, a [[Sith sorcerer]] could channel the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side of the Force]] into a weapon so strong it could rip the core right out of a [[Star/Legends|star]]. The sorcerer could then manipulate the core through [[The Force/Legends|the Force]], and throw it as a projectile at potential targets, vaporizing them instantly. Only the strongest masters of the dark side could fully maintain control of the [[Supernova/Legends|supernova]]. Less adept maneuvers used this technique at their own peril, for without the necessary strength in the Force the liberated core would very likely consume the caster, or set off a chain reaction of supernovae, much like what happened in the [[Cron Cluster/Legends|Cron Cluster]].<ref name="TSW4" /> A variation of this was to use the Force and directly control star power.<ref name="FOTSE5" />

==History==
{{Quote|Steer our vessel between the Denarii suns&mdash;It is time to remind the Republic of the power of the ''dark side!''|Naga Sadow|<ref name="darklords1" />}}
[[File:Denarii_supernova.png|thumb|left|250px|Naga Sadow causes the Denarii supernova]]
The ancient [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] [[Naga Sadow/Legends|Naga Sadow]] was a master of this ability. The Sith crystals he used to power the [[Corsair (Derriphan-class)|''Corsair'']] were in reality a [[Superweapon/Legends|superweapon]], imbued with the power to manipulate solar energy.<ref name="FOTSE5" /> In [[5000 BBY/Legends|5000 BBY]],<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> the Dark Lord<ref name="FOTSE5" /> flew his damaged ''Corsair'' warship between the [[Denarii Nova|Denarii binary stars]], with [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] forces in pursuit. Using his knowledge of [[Sith sorcery/Legends|Sith sorcery]], Sadow [[Battle at the Denarii Nova|manipulated]] the Denarii's suns to collide together in order to delay<ref name="darklords1" /> [[Empress/Legends|Empress]] [[Teta/Legends|Teta]] and the ensuing Republic Fleet as a last desperate measure.<ref name="FOTSE5" />

Another user of this ability was the sorceress [[Aleema Keto]], who harnessed the same power from exactly the same power source, the ''Corsair''. During the [[Battle of Kemplex Nine]], Keto unwittingly used the crystals to wrench a solar core free and hurl it at the advancing [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] [[Republic Navy/Legends|fleet]]. Keto was nowhere near as powerful as Naga Sadow, and when she tried to use the power it backfired on her; the freed solar core [[Cron Supernova/Legends|ignited nine other stars]] and consumed her, creating the [[Cron Drift/Legends|Cron Drift]]. Even so, this power was considered far grander and more massive than what was thought to be possible with the Force by the Jedi of that era.<ref name="TSW4" />
